## Roku Platform Revenue Rises 28%, Advertiser Growth Offsets Device Weakness

A 28% platform revenue print is a real-time health check on the streaming ad market; strong advertiser demand alongside device weakness confirms the business model is transitioning successfully toward higher-margin platform revenue, which is the core take-rate thesis.

- Roku platform revenue grew 28%, per headlines — a headline number that drives the debate about current valuation
- Advertiser growth is explicitly cited as the primary driver of platform outperformance
- Device (hardware) segment described as weak, creating a bifurcated business mix
- Headlines frame a live valuation debate: can the stock justify its price at this growth rate?
- No absolute revenue figures or guidance specifics appear in headlines
